book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: SAN MATEO Jesucristo yee Añurije Quetire Mateo cʉ̃ ca owarique

content: Juan're cʉ̃ja ca paa taa cõarique
Tii rʉmʉrira Galilea yepa wiogʉ Herodes, Jesús cʉ̃ ca tiirijere cʉ̃ja ca wedero tʉori,
cʉ̃re ca pade coterãre o biro ĩiupi: —Cʉ̃a, Uwo Coeri majʉ Juan niiquĩricʉ, ca cati tuaricʉ niicumi. To biri ca ĩa ñaaña manirije tii bau nii majiriquere cʉocumi —ĩiupi.
Herodes pea, cʉ̃ bai Felipe nʉmo Herodías jʉori, Juan're ñee dotiri, come daa mena jiari, tia cũurica wiipʉ cʉ̃re cũu dotiupi.
Ména, Juan pea to biro cʉ̃ tiijato ĩigʉ: “Cõre nʉmo cʉtigʉ, doti cũurique ca tii dotitirijere mʉ tii,” ĩiupi Herodes're.
Herodes pea Juan're jĩarʉga nii pacagʉ, bojoca peere uwiupi, niipetirã “Juan Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yee quetire wede jʉgueri majʉra niimi,” cʉ̃ja ca ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉogʉ cʉ̃ ca niiro macã.

To ca bii pacaro, Herodes cʉ̃ ca baʉarica rʉmʉ ʉno ca earo cʉ̃ ca tiiri boje rʉmʉre, Herodías macõ pea niipetirã Herodes cʉ̃ ca jʉo cojoricarã cʉ̃ja ca ĩa cojoropʉ bajago wia waaupo. Herodes pea cõ ca bajarijere ĩa mecʉ̃ma ĩigʉ, o biro cõre ĩiupi:
“No ca boorije mʉ ca jãirijere mʉre yʉ tiicojo majuropeecãrucu. ¡Yee méé mʉre yʉ ĩi!” cõre ĩiupi.
Cõ pea cõ paco cõ ca wede majiorico niiri, o biro ĩiupo Herodes're: —Jotʉ bapapʉ Juan dʉpʉgare jãari, yʉre tiicojoya —cʉ̃re ĩiupo.

To biro cõ ca ĩiro tʉogʉ, bʉaro tʉgoeña paiupi Herodes. Bʉari, niipetirã cʉ̃ ca jʉo cojoricarã cʉ̃ja tʉo cojoropʉ: “Mʉ ca jãirijere yʉ tiicojo majuropeecãrucu,” cʉ̃ ca ĩirique ca niiro macã, cõ ca ĩirore biro tii dotiupi.
To biri cʉ̃ ʉmʉare tia cũurica wiipʉ ca niigʉ, Juan dʉpʉgare paa taa doti cojoupi.
Jiro jotʉ bapapʉ ami jãa ami waari, wãmore cõre tiicojoupa. Cõ pea, cõ pacopʉre tiicojoupo.
To biro cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca tiiriquere queti tʉo, cʉ̃ buerã ca niiricarã eari, cʉ̃ upʉri niiquĩriquere ami waa, yaa cõa yapanori jiro, Jesús're wederã waaupa.
Paʉ bojocare Jesús cʉ̃ ca baarique ecarique

Jesús pea teere cʉ̃ja ca queti wedero tʉori, too ca niiricʉ, jãa, cʉ̃ buerã mena cũmuapʉ ea jãa, jʉo waacoawi ca bojoca maniro pee. Toopʉ jãa ca waariquere majiri, tii macãri macãrã pea maapʉ jãare nʉnʉ waaupa.
To biri Jesús ʉtabʉcʉra ape nʉñapʉ tĩa ea maa nʉcãgʉ, paʉ bojoca cʉ̃ja ca niiro ĩawi. Cʉ̃jare ĩa boo pacari, ca diarique cʉtirã cʉ̃ja ca jee waaricarãre cʉ̃jare catio bojawi.

Jãa, cʉ̃ buerã pea, naiocoaro ca biiro ĩarã Jesús pʉto pee waa, o biro cʉ̃re jãa ĩiwʉ: —Mee ñamica niicoa. Anoa ca bojoca maniropʉ nii. Bojocare, “Waarãja,” cʉ̃jare ĩiña. Macãpʉ waari, cʉ̃ja ca baapere cʉ̃ja wapa tiirã waajato —cʉ̃re jãa ĩiwʉ.
To biro jãa ca ĩiro, Jesús pea o biro jãare ĩi yʉʉwi: —Ñeere ĩirã waaticuma. Mʉjara cʉ̃jare baariquere ecaya —ĩiwi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, jãa pea: —Jãa, anora jĩcã amo cõro pan'gaariacã, wai pʉarãacã to cõrora jãa cʉo —cʉ̃re jãa ĩiwʉ.
To biro cʉ̃re jãa ca ĩiro tʉo: —Ano pee ami dooya —jãare ĩiwi Jesús.

Ĩi yapano, bojocare taa yepapʉ cʉ̃jare duwi dotiwi. Duwi doti yapano, pan jĩcã amo cõro ca niiricarire, wai pʉarã mena jeeri, ʉmʉreco pee ĩa mʉene cojori, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre: —¡Añu majuropeecã! Añurije jãare ĩa cõa peo bojaya —ĩi juu bue yapano, pan'gaarire pee batori, jãa cʉ̃ buerãre noniwi. Jãa pea bojocare jãa batowʉ.
To biro jãa ca tiirijere, niipetirãpʉra baa yapi peticoawa. Jãa pea ca dʉjarijere jee neo, pʉa amo peti, dʉpore pʉaga penituaro niiri pijeeri peti jãa jee jãa dadowʉ.
Teere ca baaricarã pea jĩcã amo cõro mil ʉmʉa niiwa, nomia, wimarã cõoña maniro niirã.
Oco jotoara Jesús cʉ̃ ca waarique
Ate jiro Jesús, jãa, cʉ̃ buerãre cũmuapʉ ea jãa dotiwi, bojocare cʉ̃ ca waarique wui ditoye, cʉ̃ jʉguero ape nʉñapʉ cʉ̃ja tĩa waa yuecãjato ĩigʉ.
Bojocare waarique wui cojo yapano, ʉ̃tãgʉ jotoapʉ jĩcʉ̃ra juu buegʉ mʉacoaupi Jesús. Ména, ca naioro jiro jĩcʉ̃ra toora niicãupi.
Mee, jãa pea yoaropʉ jãa tʉjacã tĩa waawʉ. Wino bʉaro jãa ca waaro peera paa puu dooma ĩiro, jãa cũmuare uwioro, oco jabe cõa tuu niiwʉ.
To biro jãa ca bii paja yujuro, ca boeparo jʉgueroacã jãa pʉto pee doo nʉnʉa doowi Jesús. “¡Níjá! Oco jotoara doocã nʉnʉa doowi.”
Oco jotoara cʉ̃ ca doo nʉnʉa dooro ĩa ʉcʉacoari, bʉaro uwirique mena: —Wãtĩro doo béé —jãa ĩi acaro buicoawʉ.
To biro jãa ca ĩiro, Jesús pea o biro jãare ĩi cojowi: —Yerijãa waarãja. Yʉra yʉ nii. Uwiticãña —jãare ĩiwi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, Pedro pea o biro ĩiwi Jesús're: —Wiogʉ, mʉra mʉ ca niijata, oco jotoara mʉ pʉtopʉ yʉre waa dotiya —ĩiwi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro: —Dooya —cʉ̃re ĩiwi. To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, Pedro, cũmuapʉ ca jãñaricʉ wãcã ñaa, oco jotoara Jesús cʉ̃ ca niiro díámacʉ̃ waacã nʉnʉa waawi.
Too waa nʉnʉa waagʉ, wino bʉaro ca paa puuro ĩa uwima ĩigʉra, duacã nʉnʉa waawi. “Duacã yai waagʉ yʉ bii,” ĩima ĩigʉra, o biro ĩi acaro buiwi Pedro: —Wiogʉ, yʉre ñeegʉ dooya —ĩiwi Jesús're.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩirora, Jesús pea cʉ̃ amore juu cojo, cʉ̃re ñeeri, o biro cʉ̃re ĩiwi: —¡Petoacã peti yʉre mʉ tʉo nʉnʉjeecã! ¿Ñee tiigʉ, “Yʉre tii nemocãrucumi,” mʉ ĩi tʉgoeña bayitijãri? —ĩiwi.
Cũmuapʉ cʉ̃ja ca ea jãarora, wino paa puu yerijãacoawʉ.
To cõrora, jãa, cũmuapʉ ca niirã pea: —Mʉa díámacʉ̃ra, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ Macʉ̃ra mʉ nii —jãa ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉowʉ Jesús're.
Genesaret'pʉ ca diarãre Jesús cʉ̃ ca catiorique
To biro bii tĩa waa, Genesaret yepapʉre jãa eawʉ.
Toopʉ jãa ca earo, too macãrã pea Jesús're ĩa majiri, too cʉ̃ ca earo, too pʉtori macãrã niipetirãpʉre queti wede bate peoticã cojoupa. Niipetirã ca diarique cʉtirãre jeecãri, Jesús pʉto
“Jãa cãare petopʉra, mʉ jutiro yapaacã ʉnorena, jãare padeña dotiya,” ĩi eawa. Niipetirã cʉ̃ jutirore ca padeñarã cõrora cati peticoawa.
